info.title: DekaSign sandbox and session API
info.description: Management endpoints are sandbox-only and may return SANDBOX_API_DISABLED on production hosts. Template authoring and human approval decisions are not machine-key APIs. Session routes are separately authenticated. Responses are intentionally extensible; narrative guides document key fields. This specification does not grant access or enable feature flags.
